newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 6.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
China is to ease controls over its citizen's travelling abroad and will simplify application procedures for exit visas.
China plans to launch more than 30 satellites for foreign countries by the year 2000.
China urges its artists and writers to develop socialist art and become engineers of human souls.
Beijing Commodity Exchange revokes membership of four firms and warns 27 others after crackdown on market irregularities.
China estimates in the next 20 years it will need to add 800 150-seat aircraft and more than 430 200-seat or larger aircraft.
